add_executable(stub-nrf src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(stub-nrf PRIVATE sbi_core)
# Absolute path to the lab PKI generated by scripts/gen-lab-pki.sh -- baked in at compile time since
# this is dev/lab tooling run from wherever CTest happens to set its CWD, not an installed artifact
# with a real config system. See docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-0011.
target_compile_definitions(stub-nrf PRIVATE CERTS_DIR="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/certs")
